title: feat(account): resolve an account from its API token
description: The browser extension only knows the API token the user pasted. Adds `POST /account/lookup`, which returns the id, name and plan of the account behind a token, or 401.
rationale: `req.body.token` goes raw into the filter: a JSON body `{"token": {"$ne": null}}` matches the first account without knowing any token. The value must be checked to be a string.

extras.note: express ^5 leaves req.body undefined without a JSON body: `req.body.token` throws and the extension gets a 500 instead of the JSON 401/400 (139's Express 4 hang claim is wrong, its body point stands)
